charts.title: K2-3 d: orbits around K2-3
charts.description: The orbits of K2-3's planets in this map from above, to scale, with K2-3 d highlighted and the direction to Earth down. Each orbit is the one the app draws, from the published period, a/R*, eccentricity and argument of periastron; the star is a marker, not to scale.

metadata.orbitSource: Howard et al. 2025 (2025ApJS..278...52H), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table (pl_refname HOWARD_ET_AL__2025): P 44.556456 d
